title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service

geometryEvidence.reference: Leroy et al. (2021), PHANGS-ALMA, ApJS 257, 43, table of galaxies (orientations from Lang et al. 2020), row NGC4303: inclination 23.5 ± 9.2°, position angle 312.4 ± 2.5°. Which edge of the disc is nearer is not in the source: the disc is drawn with the edge at position angle 42° nearer, an assumption.

displayModel: The photograph lies on one flat plane, the disc's midplane, as the Milky Way's backing image does. Nothing in the image has depth.
coverage: Stars are removed from the picture before the bake by NOX, which predicts the light under a star and does not measure it; 2 of the 2 Gaia stars brighter than G 14 in the picture had a glow, filled out to at most 78 px (17″).

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 3000 x 3000 px, 0.184 degrees wide, tangent projection on 185.478414, +4.473776, north up; no crop or resample.
